english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken Cantonese choice for a building or place immediately beside another.
Use this as the all-purpose colloquial choice for something next to something else, without necessarily saying that the two things touch.

examples.english: I live in the next-door building.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zyu6 hai2 gaak3 lei4 go2 dung6 lau4

examples.english: The pantry is adjoining my room.
examples.traditional: 我間房隔籬就係茶水間。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gaan1 fong4 gaak3 lei4 zau6 hai6 caa4 seoi2 gaan1
